about: The level-box reads of a body that scripts/check_level_box_readers.py finds, each with its class. A new read is not in this file: convert it, or add it with the class that says why the level box is right there. A line the search no longer finds must be deleted: the counts may only fall. LEVEL-BOX-READERS in docs/planning/queue.md has the table.

classes.a published view of the box the body has: `kin` on this line is a `PortalBodyView`, not a `BodyKinematics`: its size is published by the host as the collision box, turned (`publish_portal_body_views`)
classes.the half of a body in its own frame, for: the half on the body's own axes (side, DOWN), given to a reader that lays it on a frame. The perception view: the recovery lens hands it to a kernel body, which turns it, and the rollout projects on side and down. The candidates of a teleport's ambush: `ambush_arrival` lays them on the frame of the teleporter. To turn it at the source turns it twice
classes.a shot: a shot is a free body with no support and no stance: its size is its box
classes.the gravity of a body: this box is what resolves the frame of the body, so the frame cannot turn it
classes.the centre only: the reader takes the centre, which the two boxes share
classes.a scratch body with no record: `detect_oob_scratch` takes a `BodyClusterScratch`, which has no record of a step, so the level box is all it can ask. It has no production caller (the tests of the trace call it); the live recorder asks `detect_oob_of`
classes.a game with no turned gravity: Mary-O, Smash and Sanic have no room whose gravity is turned; convert when one does
classes.the camera's framing bounds: a bound of what the camera frames, not a contact
classes.inside the kernel: the kernel turns the half itself on this line, or the crawler arm states its own DOWN
classes.a lift's rider test at level gravity: `advance_moving_platforms` asks `is_supporting_body` with the feet direction `Vec2::Y`, so it asks for the box a body has when its DOWN is the level's. Not measured against a room that turns gravity under a lift; when one is authored this read takes the rider's own box and its own DOWN, as the other platform readers do.
classes.a conducted limb: a limb its conductor moves (`PoseHold::Conductor`) is a free body with no support and no stance: its size is its box, as a shot's is
